dataset: LRO Diviner Polar Cumulative Product (PCP), PDS4 urn:nasa:pds:lro_diviner_derived1, doi:10.17189/wj0s-w188
citation: Williams, J.-P., et al. (2019), Seasonal polar temperatures on the Moon, JGR Planets 124, 2505-2521, doi:10.1029/2019JE006028
note: Average bolometric surface temperature (K) of the 240 m Diviner bin containing each point, per 3.75 deg bin of subsolar longitude (east, bin i covers i*3.75 .. (i+1)*3.75 deg) and season (summer: subsolar latitude < 0), from 2009-2019 nadir observations. Bins without an observation take the mean of the 8 neighbouring 240 m bins, else linear interpolation along the subsolar longitude (*Bins counts). Min3x3/Max3x3: range of the 3x3 bins (+-240 m). check: Diviner temperature in hours our LOLA horizon model calls lit (sunFraction >= 50) vs dark.
provenance: Pipeline code written with AI assistance (Claude Code). The values are not AI-generated: they are computed deterministically from NASA LRO LOLA terrain and JPL DE421 / NAIF ephemerides (Skyfield) and validated against JPL Horizons and the NASA LOLA illumination maps.
